[A710] TAKEN
Branch: `818-wns-gate`, from dev `1e80128f`
Authoritative references: this issue; the ruling in #814 (issuecomment-6522621984, rule 1); `docs/integration/BUILDING.md` section 5 (the #395 margin decision: WNS >= +0.03 ns and WHS >= 0 at every declared corner); `docs/design/AREA_BUDGET.md` "The resource gate"; `docs/testing/PP_SHADOW_BASELINE_RECIPE.md` "Integrated measurements" (the recipe's three placement directives) and "Resource gate".
Interpreted scope: the gate is `syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate.py`; the issue names `scripts/`, which holds no file of that name. For a route endpoint, `check` and `record` take either the recipe's three directive routes (the shipping route directory and the two comparison directories the recipe writes from its synthesis checkpoint, each bound to it by its script) or one route explicitly marked as the shipping selection. The gate selects the route with the best worst-corner WNS, names its directive, reads WNS and WHS from every signoff corner report the flow's timing grade declares, and fails when the selected route is below the +0.030 ns setup or 0 ns hold floor at any corner. The fall from the record is printed as a WARNING beyond the existing 0.25 ns timing-fall column and never fails. LUT, FF, slice, RAMB and DSP tolerances, the BRAM tile ceiling and route completeness are unchanged and judged on the selected route. `record --write` stores the selected route's figures, its directive named in the record's flow identity. Docs: `AREA_BUDGET.md`, `BUILDING.md` section 5 and the recipe's gate commands. No RTL change, no Vivado run, no policy value change.
Validation plan: `pp_resource_gate.py --selftest` with each of the issue's four cases planted, `pp_resource_gate_mutants.py`, `check-baseline`, the rtl-fast step that calls the gate, the docs gates, behave; the old and new gate on dev `1e80128f`'s three recorded routes and on #814's head routes.
Blockers: none

[A710] REVIEW READY
Commit: `32f0d9b5425a8526ac9d39e5913c01944c36e4d0` (branch `818-wns-gate`, two commits on dev `1e80128f`, the live tip; not pushed by this lane)
Changed:
- `syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate.py` (the issue's `scripts/` path holds no such file): a route endpoint is judged on the recipe's three placement directives (`--comparison` for each of AltSpreadLogic_high and ExtraTimingOpt beside the shipping route) or on one route marked `--shipping-selection`; neither or both exits 2. The gate selects the best worst-corner WNS (a tie goes to the recipe's order), prints each route's worst-corner WNS and WHS, names the selected directive, and judges that route's WNS and WHS against +0.030 ns / 0 ns at every signoff corner the flow's timing grade declares, naming each corner below a floor. A fall from the record beyond the existing 0.25 ns column prints a WARNING and never fails. LUT, FF, slice, RAMB36, RAMB18, DSP and the BRAM tile ceiling are unchanged and judged on the selected route. `record --write` of a set stores the selected route, its flow naming its directive; the record's shape, the baseline and the policy table are unchanged.
- Each comparison must hold exactly the script the recipe's snippet writes from the shipping script, and takes the shipping route's inputs; every route of a set is judged on its identity (the three recipe directives compared as one), population, signoff corners (their worst must be the timing summary's) and route status.
- Arms: `syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate_set_selftest.py` (new: 21 timing arms, 29 route-set arms through `main()` including the issue's four cases, 2 standalone refusals, the set's re-record); fixtures carry the four corner reports. Mutants: 38 new, 11 rewritten.
- Docs: `docs/design/AREA_BUDGET.md`, `docs/integration/BUILDING.md` section 5, the gate commands in `docs/testing/PP_SHADOW_BASELINE_RECIPE.md`, and the stale gate row of `docs/design/MARK_II_AREA_PLAN.md`.
Validation (each rc 0):
- `python3 syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate.py --selftest`: 304 arms and 500 generated cases PASS (dev 260), placement controls PASS.
- `python3 syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate_mutants.py`: control passes, all 230 mutants fail (dev 192); each new or rewritten mutant killed by its own arm.
- `python3 syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate.py check-baseline`: baseline PASS, 3 endpoints.
- rtl-fast replica in a clean clone at the head, jobs `changes`, `bdd-conformance`, `yosys-elaboration` (its step runs the three commands above): every step success; behave 495 scenarios, 2,288 steps.
- Docs workflow replica in a clean clone at the head: 44 steps, 0 failed, 2 skipped by rule; markdown gates on CPython 3.12.3 and the no-git gates rc 0; Python idiom gate within every ratchet.
- Generated exit-code cases on real routes: 3,000 on dev's shipping route and 1,000 on #814's head route, 0 failures.
Acceptance criteria:
- The self-test passes, each of the four cases planted with its expected verdict: met.
- dev `1e80128f`'s three recorded routes from #814 round 1 pass and select ExtraPostPlacementOpt (+0.303 ns; AltSpreadLogic_high +0.230, ExtraTimingOpt +0.106): met, exit 0, every corner at or above both floors.
- The docs gates pass: met.
- Verdicts on the recorded routes change only as the ruling intends: #814's head set goes from 1 (fell 0.312) to 0 with a WARNING, the #814 control set from 1 (fell 0.272) to 0 on AltSpreadLogic_high (+0.342); dev's stays 0.
Open risks/questions:
- A non-selected comparison route that is incomplete still fails the set (exit 1), as every route the gate reads always has; leaving it out of the selection instead would be a policy choice the ruling does not make.
- A route named alone without `--shipping-selection` now exits 2 (the issue's "a single one marked"); the documented commands are updated and no CI caller passes a route.

[A10] Round 2 for PR #820. It covers R748-1 (issuecomment-6529741002) F1, F2, F3 and R1.

1. **F1.** Update the Mark II mapping procedure's `record` command in `docs/design/MARK_II_AREA_PLAN.md:1340-1346` to the route-set form, so that it runs as documented. Prove it by running the documented command on a recorded set.
2. **F2.** Print the fall WARNING whenever the fall exceeds the tolerance, also when a floor fails. Add a self-test arm for each of the two combinations, and a mutant that suppresses the warning.
3. **F3.** Test the corner-agreement guard (`pp_resource_gate.py:401`) in its safety direction: a set whose summary worst corner disagrees with the per-corner reports must be refused. Add one killed mutant.
4. **R1.** Make the PR body's mutant claim exact. Address S1 if it is cheap.

Run the same gates as round 1, and keep the existing behaviour otherwise.

[A710b] TAKEN
Branch: `818-wns-gate`, head `32f0d9b5` (PR #820); new commits on top, no rebase.
Authoritative references: this issue; the [A10] round-2 comment above; R748-1 (issuecomment-6529741002) F1, F2, F3, R1, S1; the ruling in #814 (issuecomment-6522621984, rule 1).
Interpreted scope: F1, the Mark II mapping procedure's `record` command in `docs/design/MARK_II_AREA_PLAN.md` takes the route-set form, proven by running it on a recorded set. F2, the fall WARNING prints whenever the fall exceeds the 0.25 ns column, also beside a floor REGRESSION; an arm for each combination and a mutant that suppresses it. F3, a set whose timing summary's worst WNS (and WHS) is below every corner report is refused; arms and the one-way mutant killed. R1, the PR body's mutant claim made exact; S1 if cheap. No other behaviour change.
Validation plan: `pp_resource_gate.py --selftest`, `pp_resource_gate_mutants.py`, `check-baseline`, the rtl-fast step that calls the gate, the docs gates, behave; the gate on dev `1e80128f`'s three recorded routes and #814's head routes.
Blockers: none

[A710b] REVIEW READY
Commit: `50e5d08dda6e89cf010a740cea5cf4539807db01` (branch `818-wns-gate`, two commits on `32f0d9b5`, no rebase; not pushed by this lane)
Changed:
- F2: `syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate.py:572-578` reports the floor REGRESSION and the fall WARNING together (`REGRESSION: below the floor <F> at <corners>; WARNING: fell by more than 0.25 from the record`), the WARNING summary line follows (`:537`), exit still 1. Arms: WNS and WHS each below the floor with a fall beyond the timing fall (both printed) and within it (no WARNING). Mutants `fall warned beside a floor miss` and `fall warning summarized beside a floor miss`, each killed by the WNS "both reported" arm. `docs/design/AREA_BUDGET.md:442` and `docs/testing/PP_SHADOW_BASELINE_RECIPE.md:588` say so.
- F3: no gate change (the guard at `:401` is already two-way). Arms: the timing summary's WNS (0.010) and WHS (-0.050) below every corner report and under the floor exit 2 naming the disagreement. Mutant `corners agree in both directions` (`worst < figures[figure]`) killed by the WNS arm; `corners agree in the other direction` also added and killed.
- F1: `docs/design/MARK_II_AREA_PLAN.md:1340-1347` marks the mapping record `--shipping-selection` (the map reads one routed checkpoint).
- R1: the PR body's mutant sentence is exact: of 44 new and 11 rewritten mutants (9 changed edits; `timing fall` and `timing fall boundary` keep their edits under rewritten arms), 54 are killed by a named arm or check and `every corner model read` by the fixture record's refusal before the arms run.
- S1: two set arms for the BRAM tile ceiling (selected comparison over it fails; route not selected over it passes) and two killed mutants. The four `bound()` sub-conditions stay unarmed, each redundant with a later check; stated in the PR body.
Validation (each rc 0):
- `python3 syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate.py --selftest`: 312 arms and 500 generated cases PASS, placement controls PASS.
- `python3 syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate_mutants.py`: control passes, all 236 mutants fail; each round-2 mutant run alone is killed by its own arm.
- `python3 syn/ooc/pp_resource_gate.py check-baseline`: baseline PASS, 3 endpoints. `python3 scripts/check_py_idiom.py`: rc 0.
- rtl-fast replica in a clean clone at the head, jobs `changes`, `bdd-conformance`, `yosys-elaboration`: every job success; behave 495 scenarios, 2,288 steps.
- Docs workflow replica in a clean clone at the head: 44 steps, 0 failed, 2 skipped by rule; builder leg 1 with the LiteX interpreter, the five markdown gates on CPython 3.12.3 and the no-git gates rc 0.
- F1: the documented `cp` and `record` lines, run on dev `1e80128f`'s recorded shipping route: rc 0, ExtraPostPlacementOpt recorded at 0.303; a check against that scratch record passes. The map step needs Vivado and was not run.
Acceptance criteria:
- The self-test passes with the issue's four cases planted: met (unchanged arms).
- dev `1e80128f`'s three recorded routes pass and select ExtraPostPlacementOpt (+0.303 ns): met. All 15 recorded-route runs (the three sets, reversed, marked, unmarked, record) give output byte-identical to round 1's, so no recorded verdict changes in this round.
- The docs gates pass: met.
- R748-1's 28 real-route probes at the head: 28 PASS; the floor-miss probe now prints the REGRESSION and the WARNING and exits 1.
Open risks/questions: none
